narrative: CET1 is 12.6% in September — about €430M of CET1 on €3.41bn of total risk exposure — 4.0 points above the 8.6% minimum and at the top of Aktia's 2–4 point target. Capital is not the constraint; returns are. With CIR at 63% the underlying ROE is 11.0% once credit losses normalise. Corporate growth at standardised weights uses capital fastest; asset management and life insurance growth uses almost none.

signals.title: CET1 12.6%, 4.0 points above the minimum
signals.excerpt: CET1 at the top of the 2–4 point target buffer over the 8.6% minimum requirement; S&P outlook raised to stable on 28 October 2026.

signals.title: Financial targets: ROE above 12%, cost-to-income below 60%
signals.excerpt: Growth in capital-light wealth management, a strong banking heritage and a hybrid personal + digital service model.
